# Poesis

> Poesis is a company that guides the agentic transformation of organizations: redesigning a team, a function or a whole organization so that AI agents carry defined responsibilities inside explicit workflows, under human review. Its method and engine is SAF, the Systemic Agentic Framework, which Poesis publishes as open source.

Names that are easy to confuse:

- **Poesis** is the company. It sells one service: agentic transformation.
- **SAF (Systemic Agentic Framework)** is the open-source framework Poesis builds. It is not SAFe, the Scaled Agile Framework, which is a trademark of Scaled Agile, Inc.
- **SAF Agentic Harness** (`saf-agentic-harness`) is the deterministic engine: it resolves each workflow step, checks agent write grants and artifact schemas, and records what happened.
- **SAF Agentic Organization** (`saf-agentic-organization`) is a first ready-made agentic organization for scaled agile delivery, run by the harness.

Status, read from the public repositories on 2026-11-21: both products are in alpha preview (latest pre-release 1.0.0-alpha.3, published 2026-11-08), licensed under Apache-2.0, and supported on one agent host, GitHub Copilot. They are plugins for an agent host, not a hosted service. No client case study is published yet.

- [saf-agentic-harness](https://github.com/poesis-cloud/saf-agentic-harness): source code and specification of the harness
